summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The State Street SPDR Russell 1000 Momentum Focus ETF (ONEO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of large-cap stocks from the Russell 1000 Index, selected and weighted by four factors (value, quality, small size and momentum) that are scaled by market cap. ONEO was launched on Dec 2, 2015 and is issued by State Street.

holdings.infoBox: ONEO is an equity ETF with a total of 934 individual holdings. The top holdings are AngloGold Ashanti stock at 0.80%, Archer-Daniels-Midland Company at 0.65%, The Allstate Corporation at 0.61%, Delta Air Lines at 0.57%, and Newmont at 0.56%.
